description: This file contains JavaScript code for handling form functionalities in a web application, including video URL parsing, image uploads, markdown and rich text editors, drag-and-drop file uploads, geolocation, and form auto-save features.

methods.name: parseVideoURL
methods.description: Parses a video URL to identify its type (YouTube, Vimeo, PeerTube) and constructs embed and API URLs accordingly.

methods.name: _uploadImage
methods.description: Uploads image files via AJAX, providing progress updates and handling success or error callbacks.

methods.name: _createMarkdownEditor
methods.description: Initializes a Markdown editor with toolbar options, drag-and-drop image upload, and integration with markdown preview.

methods.name: _createHtmlEditor
methods.description: Initializes a rich text (Summernote) editor with image upload, formatting, and various form functionalities.
